lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      let l1 := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)) ++
        List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
      let l2 := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
        List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
          (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      have h1 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        have h := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs (by simp_all)
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp,
          crAnTimeOrderList, h]
        simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append,
          map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
      have h2 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        have h := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs (by simp_all)
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp,
          crAnTimeOrderList, h]
        simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append,
          map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
      calc
        _ = ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) -
            𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
              ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
                𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          rw [h1, h2]
          simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
          module
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          congr 1
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
          simp only [map_sub, map_smul]
          module
        _ = ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ φs))) := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
            (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          repeat rw [mul_assoc]
          rw [← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          have h := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, l1, l2] at h ⊢
          rw [← h, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
          rw [map_mul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
              Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all)]
            module
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add, pa]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
        implies_true, pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all only [map_mul, mul_add, map_add, pb]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, implies_true, pb]
